govdocs-archive_org-nsia-OrangeCountyCA_:
Michael Granberry reported for the Los Angeles Times on a college course approved in Orange County, California. The South Orange County Community College District had approved a course teaching that a conspiracy lay behind the Kennedy assassination. Its speakers included one who claimed Israel's Mossad had masterminded the killing.

A college district voting on an assassination course raised the usual fights: academic freedom against standards, evidence against speculation. Granberry's article covers the approval and the planned speakers. The course itself is the news here. By the time of the article, the conspiracy debate had moved from paperback books into classrooms, and a public board had to decide whether it belonged there.
podcast-joerogan-Hc6pbG4wICA:
Investigative reporter George Knapp and filmmaker Jeremy Corbell join episode 1510 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Knapp has covered Area 51 and Bob Lazar since 1989, when he first put Lazar on TV. Corbell makes films from the same beat. Together they are the press wing of UFO disclosure.

They present the evidence they rate highest and describe how they work sources inside the secret world. Rogan asks what they cannot yet prove and why officials leak in hints. The episode is a strong sample of UFO journalism from its two most persistent practitioners, part history lesson and part status report.
